Chapter 10

ConfigMaps and SecretsConfigMap 与 Secret

Kubernetes dedicates two primitives to defining configuration data: the ConfigMap and the Secret. Both primitives are completely decoupled from the lifecycle of a Pod, which enables you to change their configuration data values without necessarily having to redeploy the Pod.

Kubernetes 用两个原语来定义配置数据：ConfigMap 和 Secret。这两个原语都与 Pod 的生命周期完全解耦，这让你可以修改它们的配置数据值，而不必重新部署 Pod。

In essence, ConfigMaps and Secrets store a set of key-value pairs. Those key-value pairs can be injected into a container as environment variables, or they can be mounted as a volume. Figure 10-1 illustrates these options.

从本质上说，ConfigMap 和 Secret 存储一组键值对。这些键值对可以作为环境变量注入容器，也可以作为卷挂载。图 10-1 展示了这些选项。

The ConfigMap and Secret may look almost identical in purpose and structure on the surface; however, there is a slight but significant difference. A ConfigMap stores plain-text data, for example, connection URLs, runtime flags, or even structured data like a JSON or YAML content. Secrets are better suited for representing sensitive data like passwords, API keys, or Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates and store the data in Base64-encoded form.

从表面上看，ConfigMap 和 Secret 在用途和结构上几乎相同；但二者有一个细微却重要的区别。ConfigMap 存储明文数据，例如连接 URL、运行时标志，甚至 JSON 或 YAML 内容这样的结构化数据。Secret 更适合表示敏感数据，如密码、API 密钥或安全套接层（SSL）证书，并以 Base64 编码形式存储数据。

— PDF p.149 —
Encryption of ConfigMap and Secret dataConfigMap 与 Secret 数据的加密

The cluster component that stores data of a ConfigMap and Secret object is etcd, which manages this data in unencrypted form by default. You can configure encryption of data in etcd, as described in the Kubernetes documentation. etcd encryption is not within the scope of the exam.

存储 ConfigMap 和 Secret 对象数据的集群组件是 etcd，默认以未加密形式管理这些数据。你可以按 Kubernetes 文档所述配置 etcd 中的数据加密。etcd 加密不在考试范围内。

This chapter references the concept of volumes heavily. Refer to Chapter 15 to refresh your memory on the mechanics of consuming a volume in a Pod.

本章大量引用卷（volume）的概念。请参阅第 15 章复习在 Pod 中消费卷的机制。

Coverage of Curriculum Objectives考试大纲覆盖范围

This chapter addresses the following curriculum objective: Use ConfigMaps and Secrets to configure applications.

本章对应以下考试大纲要点：使用 ConfigMap 和 Secret 配置应用。

Working with ConfigMaps使用 ConfigMap

Applications often implement logic that uses configuration data to control runtime behavior. Examples for configuration data include a connection URL and network communication options (like the number of retries or timeouts) to third-party services that differ between target deployment environments.

应用通常会实现使用配置数据来控制运行时行为的逻辑。配置数据的例子包括连接 URL，以及针对第三方服务的网络通信选项（如重试次数或超时），这些在不同目标部署环境之间会有所不同。

It’s not unusual that the same configuration data needs to be made available to multiple Pods. Instead of copy-pasting the same key-value pairs across multiple Pod definitions, you can choose to centralize the information in a ConfigMap object. The ConfigMap object holds configuration data and can be consumed by as many Pods as you want. Therefore, you will need to modify the data in only one location should you need to change it.

同一份配置数据需要提供给多个 Pod 的情况并不少见。与其在多个 Pod 定义之间复制粘贴相同的键值对，你可以选择把信息集中到一个 ConfigMap 对象中。ConfigMap 对象持有配置数据，可以被任意多个 Pod 消费。因此，如果需要更改数据，你只需在一个位置修改。

Creating a ConfigMap创建 ConfigMap

You can create a ConfigMap by emitting the imperative create configmap command. This command requires you to provide the source of the data as an option. Kubernetes distinguishes the four different options shown in Table 10-1.

你可以通过发出命令式的 create configmap 命令来创建 ConfigMap。该命令要求你以选项形式提供数据来源。Kubernetes 区分了表 10-1 所示的四种不同选项。

— PDF p.150 —

Table 10-1. Source options for data parsed by a ConfigMap

表 10-1. ConfigMap 解析数据的来源选项

OptionExampleDescription
--from-literal--from-literal=locale=en_USLiteral values, which are key-value pairs as plain text
--from-literal--from-literal=locale=en_US字面值，即以纯文本形式给出的键值对
--from-env-file--from-env-file=config.envA file that contains key-value pairs and expects them to be environment variables
--from-env-file--from-env-file=config.env包含键值对并将其视为环境变量的文件
--from-file--from-file=app-config.jsonA file with arbitrary contents
--from-file--from-file=app-config.json包含任意内容的文件
--from-file--from-file=config-dirA directory with one or many files
--from-file--from-file=config-dir包含一个或多个文件的目录

It’s easy to confuse the options --from-env-file and --from-file. The option --from-env-file expects a file that contains environment variables in the format KEY=value separated by a new line. The key-value pairs follow typical naming conventions for environment variables (e.g., the key is uppercase, and individual words are separated by an underscore character). Historically, this option has been used to process Docker Compose .env files, though you can use it for any other file containing environment variables.

--from-env-file 和 --from-file 这两个选项很容易混淆。--from-env-file 选项期望一个以 KEY=value 格式、按换行分隔的环境变量文件。这些键值对遵循环境变量的典型命名约定（例如键为大写，单词之间用下划线分隔）。历史上，该选项曾被用于处理 Docker Compose 的 .env 文件，不过你也可以把它用于任何其他包含环境变量的文件。

The --from-env-file option does not enforce or normalize the typical naming conventions for environment variables. The option --from-file points to a file or directory containing any arbitrary content. It’s an appropriate option for files with structured configuration data to be read by an application (e.g., a properties file, a JSON file, or an XML file).

--from-env-file 选项不强制或规范化环境变量的典型命名约定。--from-file 选项指向包含任意内容的文件或目录。它适合用于包含应用要读取的结构化配置数据的文件（例如 properties 文件、JSON 文件或 XML 文件）。

The following command shows the creation of a ConfigMap in action. We are simply providing the key-value pairs as literals:

下面这条命令展示了 ConfigMap 的实际创建。我们只是以字面值形式提供键值对：

$ kubectl create configmap db-config --from-literal=DB_HOST=mysql-service \
  --from-literal=DB_USER=backend
configmap/db-config created

The resulting YAML object looks like the one shown in Example 10-1. As you can see, the object defines the key-value pairs in a section named data. A ConfigMap does not have a spec section.

产生的 YAML 对象如示例 10-1 所示。如你所见，该对象在名为 data 的部分定义键值对。ConfigMap 没有 spec 部分。

Example 10-1. ConfigMap YAML manifest

示例 10-1. ConfigMap YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: db-config
data:
  DB_HOST: mysql-service
  DB_USER: backend
— PDF p.151 —

You may have noticed that the key assigned to the ConfigMap data follows the typical naming conventions used by environment variables. The intention is to consume them as such in a container.

你可能已经注意到，赋给 ConfigMap 数据的键遵循环境变量所用的典型命名约定。其意图就是在容器中以这种方式消费它们。

Consuming a ConfigMap as Environment Variables以环境变量方式消费 ConfigMap

With the ConfigMap created, you can now inject its key-value pairs as environment variables into a container. Example 10-2 shows the use of spec.containers[].envFrom[].configMapRef to reference the ConfigMap by name.

创建好 ConfigMap 后，你现在可以把它的键值对作为环境变量注入容器。示例 10-2 展示了使用 spec.containers[].envFrom[].configMapRef 按名称引用 ConfigMap。

Example 10-2. Injecting ConfigMap key-value pairs into the container

示例 10-2. 把 ConfigMap 键值对注入容器

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: backend
spec:
  containers:
  - image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
    name: backend
    envFrom:
    - configMapRef:
        name: db-config

After creating the Pod from the YAML manifest, you can inspect the environment variables available in the container by running the env Unix command:

从 YAML manifest 创建 Pod 后，你可以运行 Unix 命令 env 来检查容器中可用的环境变量：

$ kubectl exec backend -- env
...
DB_HOST=mysql-service
DB_USER=backend
...

The injected configuration data will be listed among environment variables available to the container.

被注入的配置数据会列在容器可用的环境变量之中。

Mounting a ConfigMap as a Volume把 ConfigMap 挂载为卷

Another way to configure applications at runtime is by processing a machine-readable configuration file. Say we have decided to store the database configuration in a JSON file named db.json with the structure shown in Example 10-3.

在运行时配置应用的另一种方式是处理机器可读的配置文件。假设我们决定把数据库配置存放在名为 db.json 的 JSON 文件中，其结构如示例 10-3 所示。

Example 10-3. A JSON file used for configuring database information

示例 10-3. 用于配置数据库信息的 JSON 文件

{
    "db": {
      "host": "mysql-service",
      "user": "backend"
    }
}
— PDF p.152 —

Given that we are not dealing with literal key-value pairs, we need to provide the option --from-file when creating the ConfigMap object:

由于我们处理的不是字面键值对，创建 ConfigMap 对象时需要提供 --from-file 选项：

$ kubectl create configmap db-config --from-file=db.json
configmap/db-config created

Example 10-4 shows the corresponding YAML manifest of the ConfigMap. You can see that the file name becomes the key; the contents of the file have used a multiline value.

示例 10-4 展示了该 ConfigMap 对应的 YAML manifest。你可以看到文件名成为了键；文件内容使用了多行值。

Example 10-4. ConfigMap YAML manifest defining structured data

示例 10-4. 定义结构化数据的 ConfigMap YAML manifest

apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: db-config
data:
  db.json: |-
    {
      "db": {
        "host": "mysql-service",
        "user": "backend"
      }
    }
Multiline string syntax多行字符串语法

The multiline string syntax (|-) used in this YAML structure removes the line feed and removes the trailing blank lines. For more information, see the YAML syntax for multiline strings.

这个 YAML 结构中使用的多行字符串语法（|-）会去除换行符并删除末尾空行。更多信息参见多行字符串的 YAML 语法。

The Pod mounts the ConfigMap as a volume to a specific path inside of the container with read-only permissions. The assumption is that the application will read the configuration file when starting up. Example 10-5 demonstrates the YAML definition.

Pod 把 ConfigMap 作为卷以只读权限挂载到容器内的特定路径。其假设是应用会在启动时读取该配置文件。示例 10-5 演示了该 YAML 定义。

Example 10-5. Mounting a ConfigMap as a volume

示例 10-5. 把 ConfigMap 挂载为卷

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: backend
spec:
  containers:
  - image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
    name: backend
    volumeMounts:
    - name: db-config-volume
      mountPath: /etc/config
  volumes:
  - name: db-config-volume
    configMap:
      name: db-config
  • Assigns the volume type for referencing a ConfigMap object by name.分配卷类型，以按名称引用 ConfigMap 对象。
— PDF p.153 —

To verify the correct behavior, open an interactive shell to the container. As you can see in the following commands, the directory /etc/config contains a file with the key we used in the ConfigMap. The content represents the JSON configuration:

要验证正确行为，打开一个到容器的交互式 shell。如下面命令所示，/etc/config 目录包含一个以我们在 ConfigMap 中所用键命名的文件。其内容表示 JSON 配置：

$ kubectl exec -it backend -- /bin/sh
# ls -1 /etc/config
db.json
# cat /etc/config/db.json
{
    "db": {
      "host": "mysql-service",
      "user": "backend"
    }
}

The application code can now read the file from the mount path and configure the runtime behavior as needed.

应用代码现在可以从挂载路径读取该文件，并按需配置运行时行为。

Working with Secrets使用 Secret

Data stored in ConfigMaps represents arbitrary plain-text key-value pairs. In comparison to the ConfigMap, the Secret primitive is meant to represent sensitive configuration data. A typical example for Secret data is a password or an API key for authentication.

存储在 ConfigMap 中的数据表示任意明文键值对。与 ConfigMap 相比，Secret 原语意在表示敏感配置数据。Secret 数据的典型例子是密码或用于认证的 API 密钥。

Values stored in a Secret are only encoded, not encryptedSecret 中存储的值仅为编码，并非加密

Secrets expect the value of each entry to be Base64-encoded. Base64 encodes a value, but it doesn’t encrypt it. Anyone with access to its value can decode it without problems. Therefore, storing Secret manifests in the source code repository alongside other resource files should be avoided.

Secret 期望每个条目的值都是 Base64 编码的。Base64 只是对值进行编码，并不加密。任何能访问其值的人都可以毫无困难地解码。因此，应避免把 Secret manifest 与其他资源文件一起存放在源代码仓库中。

It’s somewhat unfortunate that the Kubernetes project decided to choose the term “Secret” to represent sensitive data. The nomenclature implies that data is actually secret and therefore encrypted. To keep sensitive data secure in real-world projects, you can select from a range of options.

Kubernetes 项目选择用 “Secret” 一词来表示敏感数据，多少有些不幸。这个命名暗示数据是真正保密的、因而也是加密的。为在真实项目中保护敏感数据的安全，你可以从一系列方案中选择。

Bitnami Sealed Secrets is a production-ready and proven Kubernetes operator that uses asymmetric crypto encryption for data. The manifest representation of the data, the CRD SealedSecret, is safe to be stored in a public source code repository. You cannot decrypt this data yourself. The controller installed with the operator is the only entity that can decrypt the data. Another option is to store sensitive data in external secrets managers, e.g., HashiCorp Vault or AWS Secrets Manager, and integrate them with Kubernetes. The External Secrets Operator synchronizes Secrets from external APIs into Kubernetes. The exam only expects you to understand the built-in Secret primitive, which is covered in the following sections.

Bitnami Sealed Secrets 是一个生产就绪、经过验证的 Kubernetes operator，使用非对称加密算法对数据加密。该数据的 manifest 表示形式（CRD SealedSecret）可以安全地存放在公共源代码仓库中。你自己无法解密该数据。与 operator 一起安装的控制器是唯一能解密该数据的实体。另一个选项是把敏感数据存放在外部 Secret 管理器中（例如 HashiCorp Vault 或 AWS Secrets Manager），并将其与 Kubernetes 集成。External Secrets Operator 把外部 API 中的 Secret 同步到 Kubernetes。考试只要求你理解内置的 Secret 原语，后续小节将对此展开。

— PDF p.154 —

Creating a Secret创建 Secret

You can create a Secret with the imperative command create secret. In addition, a mandatory subcommand needs to be provided that determines the type of Secret. Table 10-2 lists the different types. Kubernetes assigns the value in the Internal Type column to the type attribute in the live object. “Specialized Secret types” on page 135 discusses other Secret types and their use cases.

你可以用命令式命令 create secret 创建 Secret。此外，还必须提供一个决定 Secret 类型的子命令。表 10-2 列出了不同类型。Kubernetes 把 Internal Type 列中的值赋给线上对象的 type 属性。第 135 页 “专用 Secret 类型” 讨论了其他 Secret 类型及其使用场景。

Table 10-2. Options for creating a Secret

表 10-2. 创建 Secret 的选项

CLI optionDescriptionInternal type
genericCreates a Secret from a file, directory, or literal valueOpaque
generic从文件、目录或字面值创建 SecretOpaque
docker-registryCreates a Secret for use with a Docker registry, e.g., to pull images from a private registry when requested by a Podkubernetes.io/dockercfg
docker-registry创建用于 Docker 仓库的 Secret，例如当 Pod 请求时从私有仓库拉取镜像kubernetes.io/dockercfg
tlsCreates a TLS Secretkubernetes.io/tls
tls创建 TLS Secretkubernetes.io/tls

The most commonly used Secret type is generic. The options for a generic Secret are exactly the same as for a ConfigMap, as shown in Table 10-3.

最常用的 Secret 类型是 generic。generic Secret 的选项与 ConfigMap 完全相同，如表 10-3 所示。

Table 10-3. Source options for data parsed by a Secret

表 10-3. Secret 解析数据的来源选项

OptionExampleDescription
--from-literal--from-literal=password=secretLiteral values, which are key-value pairs as plain text
--from-literal--from-literal=password=secret字面值，即以纯文本形式给出的键值对
--from-env-file--from-env-file=config.envA file that contains key-value pairs and expects them to be environment variables
--from-env-file--from-env-file=config.env包含键值对并将其视为环境变量的文件
--from-file--from-file=id_rsa=~/.ssh/id_rsaA file with arbitrary contents
--from-file--from-file=id_rsa=~/.ssh/id_rsa包含任意内容的文件
--from-file--from-file=config-dirA directory with one or many files
--from-file--from-file=config-dir包含一个或多个文件的目录

To demonstrate the functionality, let’s create a Secret of type generic. The command sources the key-value pairs from the literals provided as a command-line option:

为演示其功能，我们创建一个 generic 类型的 Secret。该命令从作为命令行选项提供的字面值中获取键值对：

$ kubectl create secret generic db-creds --from-literal=pwd=s3cre!
secret/db-creds created

When created using the imperative command, a Secret will automatically Base64-encode the provided value. This can be observed by looking at the produced YAML manifest. You can see in Example 10-6 that the value s3cre! has been turned into czNjcmUh, the Base64-encoded equivalent.

使用命令式命令创建时，Secret 会自动对所提供的值进行 Base64 编码。通过查看产生的 YAML manifest 可以观察到这一点。在示例 10-6 中你可以看到，值 s3cre! 已被转成其 Base64 编码等价形式 czNjcmUh。

— PDF p.155 —

Example 10-6. A Secret with Base64-encoded values

示例 10-6. 带 Base64 编码值的 Secret

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-creds
type: Opaque
data:
  pwd: czNjcmUh
  • The value Opaque for the type has been assigned to represent generic sensitive data.type 被赋值为 Opaque，用于表示通用敏感数据。
  • The plain-text value has been Base64-encoded automatically if the object has been created imperatively.如果对象是以命令式方式创建的，明文值已被自动 Base64 编码。

If you start with the YAML manifest to create the Secret object, you will need to create the Base64-encoded value if you want to assign it to the data attribute. A Unix tool that does the job is base64. The following command achieves exactly that:

如果你从 YAML manifest 开始创建 Secret 对象，并想把值赋给 data 属性，则需要自行创建 Base64 编码的值。能完成这项工作的 Unix 工具是 base64。下面这条命令正好做到这一点：

$ echo -n 's3cre!' | base64
czNjcmUh

As a reminder, if you have access to a Secret object or its YAML manifest, then you can decode the Base64-encoded value at any time with the base64 Unix tool. Therefore, you may as well specify the value in plain text when defining the manifest, which is discussed in the next section.

提醒一下：如果你能访问一个 Secret 对象或其 YAML manifest，那么随时可以用 Unix 工具 base64 解码 Base64 编码的值。因此，你在定义 manifest 时完全可以用明文指定值，下一节将讨论这一点。

Defining Secret data with plain-text values用明文值定义 Secret 数据

Having to generate and assign Base64-encoded values to Secret manifests can become cumbersome. The Secret primitive offers the stringData attribute as a replacement for the data attribute. With stringData, you can assign plain-text values in the manifest file, as shown in Example 10-7.

不得不为 Secret manifest 生成并赋上 Base64 编码的值会变得很繁琐。Secret 原语提供了 stringData 属性作为 data 属性的替代。使用 stringData，你可以在 manifest 文件中赋明文值，如示例 10-7 所示。

Example 10-7. A Secret with plain-text values

示例 10-7. 带明文值的 Secret

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-creds
type: Opaque
stringData:
  pwd: s3cre!
  • The stringData attribute allows assigning plain-text key-value pairs.stringData 属性允许赋明文键值对。
  • The value referenced by the pwd key was provided in plain-text format.pwd 键所引用的值以明文格式提供。
— PDF p.156 —

Kubernetes will automatically Base64-encode the s3cre! value upon creation of the object from the manifest. The result is the live object representation shown in Example 10-8, which you can retrieve with the command kubectl get secret db-creds -o yaml.

从 manifest 创建对象时，Kubernetes 会自动对 s3cre! 值进行 Base64 编码。结果就是示例 10-8 所示的线上对象表示，你可以用命令 kubectl get secret db-creds -o yaml 检索到它。

Example 10-8. A Secret live object

示例 10-8. Secret 线上对象

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: db-creds
type: Opaque
data:
  pwd: czNjcmUh
  • The live object of a Secret always uses the data attribute even though you may have used stringData in the manifest.Secret 的线上对象始终使用 data 属性，即使你在 manifest 中使用了 stringData。
  • The value has been Base64-encoded upon creation.该值在创建时已被 Base64 编码。

You can represent arbitrary Secret data using the Opaque type. Kubernetes offers specialized Secret types you can choose from should the data fit specific uses cases. The next section discusses those specialized Secret types.

你可以使用 Opaque 类型表示任意 Secret 数据。如果数据适合特定使用场景，Kubernetes 还提供了专用的 Secret 类型供选择。下一节讨论这些专用 Secret 类型。

Specialized Secret types专用 Secret 类型

Instead of using the Opaque Secret type, you can also use one of the specialized types to represent configuration data for particular use cases. The type kubernetes.io/basic-auth is meant for basic authentication and expects the keys username and password. At the time of writing, Kubernetes does not validate the correctness of the assigned keys.

除了使用 Opaque Secret 类型，你也可以使用某个专用类型来表示特定使用场景的配置数据。类型 kubernetes.io/basic-auth 用于基本认证，并期望键为 username 和 password。写作本书时，Kubernetes 不验证所赋键的正确性。

The created object from this definition automatically Base64-encodes the values for both keys. Example 10-9 illustrates a YAML manifest for a Secret with type kubernetes.io/basic-auth.

从该定义创建的对象会自动对两个键的值进行 Base64 编码。示例 10-9 演示了一个类型为 kubernetes.io/basic-auth 的 Secret 的 YAML manifest。

Example 10-9. Usage of the Secret type kubernetes.io/basic-auth

示例 10-9. Secret 类型 kubernetes.io/basic-auth 的用法

apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: secret-basic-auth
type: kubernetes.io/basic-auth
stringData:
  username: bmuschko
  password: secret
— PDF p.157 —
  • Uses the stringData attribute to allow for assigning plain-text values使用 stringData 属性以允许赋明文值
  • Specifies the mandatory keys required by the kubernetes.io/basic-auth Secret type指定 kubernetes.io/basic-auth Secret 类型所要求的必填键

Consuming a Secret as Environment Variables以环境变量方式消费 Secret

Consuming a Secret as environment variables works similar to the way you’d do it for ConfigMaps. Here, you’d use the YAML expression spec.containers[].envFrom[].secretRef to reference the name of the Secret. Example 10-10 injects the Secret named secret-basic-auth as environment variables into the container named backend.

以环境变量方式消费 Secret 的方式与 ConfigMap 类似。这里你会使用 YAML 表达式 spec.containers[].envFrom[].secretRef 来引用 Secret 的名称。示例 10-10 把名为 secret-basic-auth 的 Secret 作为环境变量注入名为 backend 的容器。

Example 10-10. Injecting Secret key-value pairs into the container

示例 10-10. 把 Secret 键值对注入容器

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: backend
spec:
  containers:
  - image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
    name: backend
    envFrom:
    - secretRef:
        name: secret-basic-auth

Inspecting the environment variables in the container reveals that the Secret values do not have to be decoded. That’s something Kubernetes does automatically. Therefore, the running application doesn’t need to implement custom logic to decode the value. Note that Kubernetes does not verify or normalize the typical naming conventions of environment variables, as you can see in the following output:

检查容器中的环境变量会发现，Secret 值无需你解码。这是 Kubernetes 自动做的事情。因此，运行中的应用不需要实现自定义逻辑来解码值。注意 Kubernetes 不验证或规范化环境变量的典型命名约定，如下面输出所示：

$ kubectl exec backend -- env
...
username=bmuschko
password=secret
...
— PDF p.158 —

Remapping Environment Variable Keys重映射环境变量键

Sometimes, key-value pairs stored in a Secret do not conform to typical naming conventions for environment variables or can’t be changed without impacting running services. You can redefine the keys used to inject an environment variable into a Pod with the spec.containers[].env[].valueFrom attribute. Example 10-11 turns the key username into USER and the key password into PWD.

有时，Secret 中存储的键值对不符合环境变量的典型命名约定，或者在不影响运行中服务的情况下无法更改。你可以用 spec.containers[].env[].valueFrom 属性重新定义用于把环境变量注入 Pod 的键。示例 10-11 把键 username 转成 USER，把键 password 转成 PWD。

Example 10-11. Remapping environment variable keys for Secret entries

示例 10-11. 为 Secret 条目重映射环境变量键

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: backend
spec:
  containers:
  - image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
    name: backend
    env:
    - name: USER
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: secret-basic-auth
          key: username
    - name: PWD
      valueFrom:
        secretKeyRef:
          name: secret-basic-auth
          key: password

The resulting environment variables available to the container now follow the typical conventions for environment variables, and we changed how they are consumed by the application code:

结果，容器可用的环境变量现在遵循环境变量的典型约定，并且我们改变了应用代码消费它们的方式：

$ kubectl exec backend -- env
...
USER=bmuschko
PWD=secret
...

The same mechanism of reassigning environment variables works for ConfigMaps. You’d use the attribute spec.containers[].env[].valueFrom.configMapRef instead.

同样的环境变量重指派机制也适用于 ConfigMap。你会改用属性 spec.containers[].env[].valueFrom.configMapRef。

— PDF p.159 —

Mounting a Secret as a Volume把 Secret 挂载为卷

To demonstrate mounting a Secret as a volume, we’ll create a new Secret of type kubernetes.io/ssh-auth. This Secret type captures the value of an SSH private key that you can view using the command cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa. To process the SSH private key file with the create secret command, it needs to be available as a file with the name ssh-privatekey:

为演示把 Secret 挂载为卷，我们将创建一个类型为 kubernetes.io/ssh-auth 的新 Secret。该 Secret 类型捕获 SSH 私钥的值，你可以用命令 cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa 查看它。要使用 create secret 命令处理该 SSH 私钥文件，它需要以名为 ssh-privatekey 的文件存在：

$ cp ~/.ssh/id_rsa ssh-privatekey
$ kubectl create secret generic secret-ssh-auth --from-file=ssh-privatekey \
  --type=kubernetes.io/ssh-auth
secret/secret-ssh-auth created

Mounting the Secret as a volume follows the two-step approach: define the volume first, and then reference it as a mount path for one or many containers. The volume type is called secret, as used in Example 10-12.

把 Secret 挂载为卷遵循两步方式：先定义卷，然后把它引用为一个或多个容器的挂载路径。卷类型称为 secret，如示例 10-12 所用。

Example 10-12. Mounting a Secret as a volume

示例 10-12. 把 Secret 挂载为卷

apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: backend
spec:
  containers:
  - image: bmuschko/web-app:1.0.1
    name: backend
    volumeMounts:
    - name: ssh-volume
      mountPath: /var/app
      readOnly: true
  volumes:
  - name: ssh-volume
    secret:
      secretName: secret-ssh-auth
  • Files provided by the Secret mounted as volume cannot be modified.由 Secret 挂载为卷所提供的文件不能被修改。
  • Note that the attribute secretName that points to the Secret name is not the same as for the ConfigMap (which is name).注意，指向 Secret 名称的属性 secretName 与 ConfigMap（使用 name）不同。

You will find the file named ssh-privatekey in the mount path /var/app. To verify, open an interactive shell and render the file contents. The contents of the file are not Base64-encoded:

你会在挂载路径 /var/app 中找到名为 ssh-privatekey 的文件。为验证，打开一个交互式 shell 并渲染文件内容。该文件的内容不是 Base64 编码的：

$ kubectl exec -it backend -- /bin/sh
# ls -1 /var/app
ssh-privatekey
# cat /var/app/ssh-privatekey
-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
Proc-Type: 4,ENCRYPTED
DEK-Info: AES-128-CBC,8734C9153079F2E8497C8075289EBBF1
...
-----END RSA PRIVATE KEY-----
— PDF p.160 —

Summary本章小结

Application runtime behavior can be controlled either by injecting configuration data as environment variables or by mounting a volume to a path. In Kubernetes, this configuration data is represented by the API resources ConfigMap and Secret in the form of key-value pairs. A ConfigMap is meant for plain-text data, and a Secret encodes the values in Base64 to obfuscate the values. Secrets are a better fit for sensitive information like credentials and SSH private keys.

应用的运行时行为可以通过把配置数据作为环境变量注入，或者把卷挂载到路径来控制。在 Kubernetes 中，这种配置数据由 API 资源 ConfigMap 和 Secret 以键值对形式表示。ConfigMap 用于明文数据，而 Secret 以 Base64 对值进行编码以混淆它们。Secret 更适合凭证和 SSH 私钥这类敏感信息。

Exam Essentials考试要点

  • Practice creating ConfigMap objects with the imperative and declarative approaches: The quickest ways to create those objects are the imperative kubectl create configmap commands. Understand how to provide the data with the help of different command-line flags. The ConfigMap specifies plain-text key-value pairs in the data section of YAML manifest.练习以命令式和声明式方式创建 ConfigMap 对象：创建这些对象最快的方式是命令式命令 kubectl create configmap。理解如何借助不同的命令行标志提供数据。ConfigMap 在 YAML manifest 的 data 部分指定明文键值对。
  • Practice creating Secret objects with the imperative and declarative approaches: Creating a Secret using the imperative command kubectl create secret does not require you to Base64-encode the provided values. kubectl performs the encoding operation automatically. The declarative approach requires the Secret YAML manifest to specify a Base64-encoded value with the data section. You can use the stringData convenience attribute in place of the data attribute if you prefer providing a plain-text value. The live object will use a Base64-encoded value. Functionally, there’s no difference at runtime between the use of data and stringData.练习以命令式和声明式方式创建 Secret 对象：使用命令式命令 kubectl create secret 创建 Secret 时，不要求你对所提供的值进行 Base64 编码。kubectl 会自动执行编码操作。声明式方式要求 Secret YAML manifest 在 data 部分指定 Base64 编码的值。如果你更喜欢提供明文值，可以使用便捷属性 stringData 代替 data 属性。线上对象将使用 Base64 编码的值。在运行时，使用 data 与 stringData 在功能上没有区别。
  • Understand the purpose of specialized Secret types: Secrets offer specialized types, e.g., kubernetes.io/basic-auth or kubernetes.io/service-account-token, to represent data for specific use cases. Read up on the different types in the Kubernetes documentation, and understand their purpose.理解专用 Secret 类型的用途：Secret 提供了专用类型，例如 kubernetes.io/basic-auth 或 kubernetes.io/service-account-token，用于表示特定使用场景的数据。请阅读 Kubernetes 文档中关于不同类型的内容，并理解它们的用途。
  • Know how to inspect ConfigMap and Secret data: The exam may confront you with existing ConfigMap and Secret objects. You need to understand how to use the kubectl get or the kubectl describe command to inspect the data of those objects. The live object of a Secret will always represent the value in a Base64-encoded format.掌握如何检查 ConfigMap 和 Secret 数据：考试可能会让你面对已存在的 ConfigMap 和 Secret 对象。你需要理解如何使用 kubectl get 或 kubectl describe 命令检查这些对象的数据。Secret 的线上对象始终以 Base64 编码格式表示值。
  • Exercise the consumption of ConfigMaps and Secrets in Pods: The primary use case for ConfigMaps and Secrets is the consumption of the data from a Pod. Pods can inject configuration data into a container as environment variables or mount the configuration data as volumes. For the exam, you need to be familiar with both consumption methods.练习在 Pod 中消费 ConfigMap 和 Secret：ConfigMap 和 Secret 的主要使用场景是从 Pod 中消费其数据。Pod 可以把配置数据作为环境变量注入容器，或把配置数据作为卷挂载。考试中你需要熟悉这两种消费方式。
— PDF p.161 —

Sample Exercises样题练习

Solutions to these exercises are available in Appendix A.

这些练习的参考答案见附录 A。

  1. In this exercise, you will first create a ConfigMap from a YAML configuration file as a source. Later, you’ll create a Pod, consume the ConfigMap as volume, and inspect the key-value pairs as files. Navigate to the directory app-a/ch10/configmap of the checked-out GitHub repository bmuschko/cka-study-guide. Inspect the YAML configuration file named application.yaml. Create a new ConfigMap named app-config from that file. Create a Pod named backend that consumes the ConfigMap as volume at the mount path /etc/config. The container runs the image nginx:1.23.4-alpine. Shell into the Pod and inspect the file at the mounted volume path.在本练习中，你首先将从一个 YAML 配置文件创建 ConfigMap 作为数据源。之后，你将创建一个 Pod、把该 ConfigMap 作为卷消费，并以文件形式检查键值对。进入已 clone 的 GitHub 仓库 bmuschko/cka-study-guide 的 app-a/ch10/configmap 目录。检查名为 application.yaml 的 YAML 配置文件。从该文件创建一个名为 app-config 的新 ConfigMap。创建一个名为 backend 的 Pod，在挂载路径 /etc/config 处把该 ConfigMap 作为卷消费。容器运行镜像 nginx:1.23.4-alpine。shell 进入该 Pod 并在挂载卷路径处检查该文件。
  2. You will first create a Secret from literal values in this exercise. Next, you’ll create a Pod and consume the Secret as environment variables. Finally, you’ll print out its values from within the container. Create a new Secret named db-credentials with the key-value pair db-password=passwd. Create a Pod named backend that uses the Secret as an environment variable named DB_PASSWORD and runs the container with the image nginx:1.23.4-alpine. Shell into the Pod and print out the created environment variables. You should be able to find the DB_PASSWORD variable.在本练习中，你首先将从字面值创建一个 Secret。接着，你将创建一个 Pod 并把该 Secret 作为环境变量消费。最后，你将从容器内打印出其值。创建一个名为 db-credentials 的新 Secret，包含键值对 db-password=passwd。创建一个名为 backend 的 Pod，把该 Secret 用作名为 DB_PASSWORD 的环境变量，并使用镜像 nginx:1.23.4-alpine 运行容器。shell 进入该 Pod 并打印出所创建的环境变量。你应当能找到 DB_PASSWORD 变量。
— PDF p.162 —
